site.title: Joseph Victor Paduga — Full-stack freelance developer

hero.headline: Full-stack developer.
hero.summary: BS Computer Science, 2025. I build and deploy the whole stack: From database to interface. Most recent role: sole developer for an international logistics company portal application. Primary languages are TypeScript, Java, and PHP.

about.heading: What I've worked on
paragraphs: My main freelance project is a full-stack [logistics platform](https://jamcargoexpress.com) for a Canada-Philippines cargo company. It handles shipment declarations, barcode scanning, warehouse receiving, billing, and a partner rewards program.
Built with Angular, Laravel, MySQL, Docker, and Claude Code, with role-based access and CI/CD deployment.

projects.title: Ledgerline
projects.summary: Imports a bank CSV, categorises transactions against user-editable rules, and charts monthly spending. Aggregation runs in Postgres; the React client renders the results.

projects.title: Standby
projects.summary: An office-hours queue for a 300-student course. Queue state is in Redis, position updates are pushed over WebSockets, and TAs can reorder the line. In use for two semesters.

projects.title: Fernpost
projects.summary: A static blog engine that renders markdown to HTML files. A single Go binary, with a SQLite index for full-text search. Publishes the notes section of this site.

projects.title: Transitless
projects.summary: A departure board for a single bus stop. Polls a GTFS-realtime feed, reconciles it against the published schedule, and displays the next three arrivals.
